acceptanceCriteria: Version and universe probes use the remaining shard budget and no further discovery probe or adapter launches after expiry.
A deterministic short-budget fixture proves discovery is cancelled at the shard deadline, later probes do not start, and the receipt is INCOMPLETE.
body: Reviewed 0927631cee801f3c0b53d9bf1b6a28d1641d87cf..c204e926210374f06dcae61772f230b2509bf334 in corvint-v1-0040. Core installed 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456; Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.456. internal/sessiontest/run.go:194-195 establishes a shard deadline, but Execute calls discover with the original context at line 212, and probe uses an independent 2m timeout at line 405. Discovery never checks the shard deadline. Reproduction using a temporary Go overlay: two declared units with distinct fake runners, each --version sleeping 200ms; Runner.Budget=50ms. Execute took 729.724666ms, launched both version probes, launched zero tests and returned INCOMPLETE. Expected: discovery shares the total shard deadline, with no probes launched after expiry. Actual: later probes are still launched after the budget; a sufficiently large admitted set of distinct slow declared runners can exceed the default 6h local shard bound. Focused internal/sessiontest tests passed; overlay was removed without source edits.
title: Session runner discovery can exceed the shard budget and launch probes after expiry
